name: Bundle Class Demo
description: Olivero sub-theme with a node--article.html.twig template that demonstrates calling a bundle-class method. Shipped inside the bundle_classes project.
project_description: A companion Olivero sub-theme bundled with the Bundle Classes example project. Its node--article.html.twig overrides Olivero's article node template to call {{ node.getLastUpdatedDate }}, the method added by the Article bundle class, showing a bundle-class method used directly from a template. It is a demonstration theme only.
